messages:
olivia: Heads up — opened a short docs PR to clarify rate limit tiers, quota consumption math, and a few dashboard links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

sam: thanks. is this because enterprise bursts were showing unexpected behaviour in the billing demo?

olivia: yes. Billing reported confusion: customers expect unused burst tokens to carry over. We should explicitly call out that burst is windowed, not banked. Added a short example and a note in the FAQs.

kevin: linking the PR now. main thing: can we add an SDK snippet showing how to read the X-RateLimit headers and compute remaining tokens? quick example would help.

maria: I can add the node + python snippets. suggested header names: `x-rw-quota-limit`, `x-rw-quota-remaining`, `x-rw-quota-reset` — are those final?

prashant: yes those match the runtime response headers. minor rename: use `x-rw-burst-available` for burst-specific count. update the doc and I'll sync runtime if needed.

maria: added drafts. sample python:
```
# python
resp = client.generate(...)
limit = int(resp.headers.get('x-rw-quota-limit'))
remaining = int(resp.headers.get('x-rw-quota-remaining'))
reset = int(resp.headers.get('x-rw-quota-reset'))
```

maria: node snippet also added with parseInt.

sam: also flag the dashboard link — existing docs link to old "metering" dashboard path `/dash/metering` but prod is `/dash/billing/usage`. changed in PR?

olivia: yep fixed the link; left a note for marketing to update any embed screenshots.

kevin: editorial: add a short "edge cases" section for quickly hitting quota with streaming tokens (tokens for events vs final tokens). Put a small table

olivia: table would be good but keep it minimal. I've added three rows: streaming preflight, aggregation across models, and shared-team limits.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR 482 assigned to @maria, @kevin. Review due in 48h.

maria: done with updates, running locally. @prashant can you confirm that the `x-rw-burst-available` header is present on dedicated nodes? I tested hosted.

prashant: confirmed on dedicated, value is integer or `null` when not applicable. I added note in PR about `null` behavior.

olivia: sweet. last asks: please add a short migration snippet for teams upgrading from tier v1 to v2 — highlight changed default quota units (tokens -> effective units) and show conversion formula.

sam: I'll write the conversion blurb. formula: effective_units = ceil(tokens * weight_factor) where weight_factor depends on model and embedding. add link to `/docs/rate-limits/units`.

olivia: perfect. I think we can merge after kevin's editorial pass and a quick runbook update. thanks all :tada:

kevin: editorial pass done, small grammar fixes. LGTM from docs side.

olivia: merging in 15m unless any blocking comments.

maria: no blockers from me.

prashant: none.

olivia: merged. closing thread — will follow up if any post-merge issues.
